rationale: Identity: in the held 3 FR 1965 page, the text before '[No. 7946]' (OCR '79461') is the order of August 9, 1938 limiting Canadian red cedar shingle imports. Its sole command applies only 'during the last six months of the calendar year 1938', so it ended on its own terms on December 31, 1938. The held EO 8051 text (4 FR 959, Feb. 15, 1939) confirms this: it recites that EO 7946 covered July 1 to December 31, 1938 and sets the limit for the first half of 1939. The ending rests on the original's own period wording, which is held and checked, with 8051 as corroboration. No held source extends the order. Provisional no is supported.
